method: Direct visual inspection of both original retained PNGs; no redraw, image editing, or substituted rendering.

observations: The complete centered Rename worksheet dialog is readable at 1600 by 1000 pixels.
The Reference input and complete red validation guidance are visible; guidance wraps within the dialog without clipping.
Cancel and Rename controls are fully visible, with the worksheet and bottom worksheet selector retained behind the modal.
Arabic menu and ribbon labels show joined Arabic glyphs at 390 by 1000 pixels.
The lower worksheet name/selector and rename pencil remain visible inside the narrow viewport.
The filename is ellipsized, and the grid has a horizontal scroll control; the capture does not claim that every wide ribbon control fits simultaneously.
Visible worksheet rows and cells remain legible and the bottom bar is not cut off.

scope: Readability and clipping of the captured duplicate-name dialog and narrow Arabic worksheet/navigation controls. Independent semantic/font/source checks are separate. This does not certify every viewport, translation, or native Office rendering.
